cohort: The study included 663,024 live births in Finland recorded in the Medical Birth Register from 2008 to 2019.
finding: The 70% increase in the rate of labour induction in Finland has not led to a significant increase in the rate of caesarean delivery, which remained one of the lowest in the world.
mod_finding: In multivariate logistic regression analysis, induction of labour was associated with a reduced risk for caesarean delivery (OR 0.72, 95% CI 0.71 to 0.74).
